description:
Mike Campbell recollects the Replacements on the Full Moon Fever Tour
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Mike Campbell (Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers, The Dirty Knobs) looks back on touring with Minneapolis band The Replacements on Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers' Full Moon Fever Tour in the late 1980s. "They were beautifully indignant about opening for us," Campbell recalls.

Hear more about it from Mike Campbell in the interview video above.
